events.title: MHK Q1 Deep Dive: Inflation, Price Increases, and Uncertain Demand Shape Outlook
events.body: Flooring manufacturer Mohawk Industries (NYSE:MHK) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q1 CY2026, but sales rose 8% year on year to $2.73 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.90 per share was 4.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
